subject: maths
question: A sum becomes 4 times its original value in 6 years under compound interest. In how many years will it become 16 times of the original amount?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount becomes 4 times in 6 years

Required amount = 16 times

**Formula Used:**

A = P × (1 + r)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ 4P = P × (1 + r)⁶

⇒ (1 + r)⁶ = 4

⇒ 16P = P × (1 + r)t

⇒ (1 + r)t = 16

⇒ 16 = 4²

⇒ (1 + r)t = ((1 + r)⁶)²

⇒ (1 + r)t = (1 + r)¹²

⇒ t = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**
